description: Declarations in JSON that the strict reader refuses in the hashable profile, each with the one issue it reports.

cases.description: A declaration that starts with a byte-order mark (the draft's edge3).

issues.message: The input starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark.

cases.description: A key that repeats an earlier key of the same object (the draft's bad6).
A null, which the hashable profile does not allow (the draft's bad5).

issues.message: A null at byte 33 is not allowed in the hashable profile.

cases.description: A title written in NFD with escapes, which a hashable document cannot hold (the draft's edge2).

issues.message: The string at byte 33 is not in Unicode normalisation form C (NFC).

cases.description: NaN in place of a bound (the draft's edge4).

issues.message: 'NaN' at byte 113 is not a JSON value.

cases.description: An integer above 9007199254740991 as a bound (E-verify e7).

issues.message: The integer 9007199254740993 at byte 113 lies outside the range from -9007199254740991 to 9007199254740991.

cases.description: 1e21 as a bound, an integer outside the range of the profile although it has one significant digit (E-verify e6).

issues.message: The integer 1e21 at byte 113 lies outside the range from -9007199254740991 to 9007199254740991.

cases.description: A bound with 17 significant digits (E-verify e10).

issues.message: The number 1.0000000000000002 at byte 113 has more than 15 significant digits.

cases.description: The smallest subnormal double as a bound (E-verify e5).

issues.message: The number 5e-324 at byte 110 is smaller in magnitude than 1e-307.

cases.description: An unpaired surrogate escape in the title (E-verify e9).

issues.message: Unpaired surrogate escape in a string at byte 33.

cases.description: A variables key outside the BMP after one inside it (E-verify e8).

issues.message: The key at byte 71 contains a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.

cases.description: A title with the byte FF, which is not UTF-8.
A title with an escaped U+0000.

issues.message: The string at byte 33 contains the character U+0000.

cases.description: An empty key in the variables block.
A title with U+1E4EC, which Unicode 14.0 does not assign, followed by U+0316 (conventions.md, NFC).

issues.message: The string at byte 33 contains a character that Unicode 14.0 does not assign, so the packages cannot normalise it in the same way.

cases.description: A trailing comma in the list of features.
An unquoted word as the goal, whose first letter 'e' does not start a number.
